versions.subject: rule: SharpEvtMute
versions.detection:
selection:
   - Image|endswith: '\SharpEvtMute.exe'
   - Description: 'SharpEvtMute'
   - CommandLine|contains:
         - '--Filter "rule '
         - '--Encoded --Filter \"'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\SharpEvtMute.exe" OR Description="SharpEvtMute" OR CommandLine IN ("*--Filter \"rule *", "*--Encoded --Filter \\\"*")
